{{Quote|Why must all my trips to Kalarba always be so eventful<!--Yes, an exclamation point without a question mark.-->!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Droids (1994) 1">[[Droids (1994) 1|''Droids'' (1994) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Kalarba''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Kalarba was a pleasant and largely undeveloped world near several powerful and rich Mid Rim systems. The planet was covered in a large world-spanning ocean and the landmasses were dominated by mountain ranges including the [[Three Peaks of Tharen]] and rocky coastlines. Because of its undeveloped beauty, the planet greatly profited from tourism.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

The native [[Vynock/Legends|vynock]] was a silicon-based lifeform which flourished in planetary atmospheres in contrast with its cousin the [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] which lived in space.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

The planet's two moons were the ash-covered [[Indobok]] which was home to the [[B'rknaa]] species and advanced [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]] which was entirely covered by a vast [[Esseles-class space station|Esseles-class Space Station]]<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> built by [[Alderaan Royal Engineers]] during the early millennia of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a docking and transfer point for [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==History==
Though one of its moons, [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]], had been settled during the early years of the Galactic Republic, Kalarba was only settled during the last centuries of the Republic. The descendants of these colonists have since developed a high opinion of self worth and a great strength of spirit which is said to be embodied within the Three Peaks of Tharen, a widely-visited mountain range near the planet's equatorial zone.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Kalarba was one of ten Mid Rim planets that loosened immigration restrictions to allow for the resettlement of beings displaced by the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN52" /> The planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Wena Havid]] served as its governor.

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. After the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched its main liberation campaign against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. After the [[Battle of Glom Tho]], the Imperial forces abandoned Kalarba and the New Republic settled on the planet. This New Republic forces later linked up there with a task force coming from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] in order to [[Battle of Druckenwell (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attack]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Battle of Kalarba|destroyed]] the planet during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by [[Yo'gand's Core|crashing]] Hosk Station into its surface. Luckily, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was able to evacuate some of the population.
